'''Nina Gallendo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] active during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She made frequent stops to the [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and often gave advice to fellow smugglers.
